metadata.data_integrity: All data sourced from Polymarket MCP API, Polymarket web pages, and WebSearch. No data fabricated.
metadata.context_note: Supreme Court struck down IEEPA tariffs 6-3 on Feb 20, 2026. Trump announced new 10% global tariff under Section 122 within hours.

macro_events.resolution: 2 consecutive quarters negative GDP (BEA) or NBER announcement
macro_events.etn_relevance: HIGH - Recession directly impacts industrial capex, construction spending, and Eaton's Electrical Americas/Global segments. 24% probability = moderate tail risk to demand thesis.

macro_events.resolution: BEA full-year 2026 GDP growth rate below 0%
macro_events.etn_relevance: MEDIUM - Full-year negative GDP would severely impact all Eaton segments. Low probability (11%) but important for bear scenario modeling.

macro_events.event: Fed Rate Cuts in 2026 - How Many
macro_events.etn_relevance: HIGH - Rate cuts stimulate construction/infrastructure spending, core demand driver for Eaton. 2-3 cuts most likely (50% combined probability). Current rate: 3.50-3.75%. Fed held in Jan 2026 after 3 consecutive cuts in late 2025.
MEDIUM - Near-term rate stability. 93% no change in March = continued elevated rate environment near-term. Cuts likely H2 2026.

macro_events.event: How High Will Inflation Get in 2026
macro_events.etn_relevance: HIGH - 30% chance inflation exceeds 3% = potential for higher-for-longer rates, but also supports Eaton's pricing power thesis. Industrial companies with strong market position can pass through inflation. New Section 122 tariff adds upward inflation pressure.

industry_events.event: AI Data Center Moratorium Passed Before 2027
industry_events.resolution: Bill prohibiting/suspending new AI data center construction passed into law
industry_events.etn_relevance: CRITICAL - Eaton's data center electrical infrastructure (PDUs, UPS, switchgear, busway) is a primary growth driver. 31% moratorium probability = material risk to the data center demand thesis. Even partial restrictions would slow Eaton's highest-margin growth vertical. Context: Bernie Sanders proposed moratorium; bipartisan energy/environmental concerns growing.

dm_anchor.note: Low volume ($7.3K) suggests thin market; probability may be less reliable

industry_events.event: Supreme Court Rules in Favor of Trump's Tariffs (IEEPA)
industry_events.resolution: SCOTUS reverses Federal Circuit's Aug 29, 2025 decision in V.O.S. Selections v. Trump
industry_events.resolution_note: Supreme Court ruled 6-3 on Feb 20, 2026 that IEEPA tariffs are unlawful. Market resolved to No.
industry_events.etn_relevance: HIGH - IEEPA tariffs struck down removes one layer of tariff risk. However, Trump immediately announced new 10% global tariff under Section 122 of Trade Act of 1974. Net impact on Eaton's input costs depends on Section 122 implementation and durability.

industry_events.event: New 10% US Blanket Tariff in Effect by February 28, 2026
industry_events.resolution: New general/blanket US tariff of 10%+ on imports goes into effect
industry_events.etn_relevance: HIGH - 89.5% probability of new 10% blanket tariff by Feb 28. Eaton sources components globally (Mexico, China, Europe). 10% blanket tariff increases COGS for imported components. Eaton management has stated they have a 'playbook' for tariff mitigation via pricing/sourcing, but lag between implementation and price recovery compresses margins near-term.

industry_events.event: Court Forces Trump to Refund Tariffs by June 30, 2026
industry_events.resolution: Appeal denied + actual refunds issued to importers for tariffs invalidated by May 28, 2025 ruling
industry_events.etn_relevance: MEDIUM - If tariff refunds are ordered, Eaton could receive retroactive refunds on previously paid duties. 32% probability. Potential one-time cash benefit, but uncertain magnitude.

industry_events.event: Tariff Increase on Canada in Effect by June 30, 2026
industry_events.etn_relevance: MEDIUM - Eaton has manufacturing operations in Canada. Additional Canada-specific tariffs would impact cross-border supply chain. 20.5% probability = low but non-trivial risk.

industry_events.event: 100% Tariff on Canada in Effect by June 30, 2026
industry_events.etn_relevance: LOW - Extreme scenario. 9% probability. Would severely disrupt Eaton's North American supply chain if enacted.

industry_events.event: Trump Creates Tariff Dividend by March 31, 2026
industry_events.etn_relevance: LOW - Tariff dividend to consumers would be mildly stimulative for economy but minimal direct Eaton impact. 9.5% probability.

industry_events.event: US Tariff Revenue Up in Q4 2025
industry_events.etn_relevance: LOW - Confirms tariff regime was revenue-generating. Contextual data point for tariff durability assessment.

scotus_tariff_ruling_feb20.summary: Supreme Court ruled 6-3 on Feb 20, 2026 that Trump's IEEPA-based tariffs exceed presidential authority. Within hours, Trump announced new 10% global tariff under Section 122 of Trade Act of 1974.
scotus_tariff_ruling_feb20.etn_implication: Net tariff regime uncertainty remains elevated. IEEPA tariffs (which were broad and variable by country) are gone, replaced by a flatter 10% blanket tariff. For Eaton: (1) Simplification may be slightly positive for planning, (2) 10% blanket is generally lower than prior IEEPA rates for some countries (China was 54%+), (3) Section 122 legality will be challenged, adding uncertainty, (4) Pre-existing Section 232 (steel/aluminum) and Section 301 (China tech) tariffs remain.

fed_rate_environment.last_action: Hold (Jan 28, 2026) after 3 consecutive 25bp cuts in late 2025
fed_rate_environment.market_expectation: 2-3 cuts in 2026 (50% combined probability), mostly H2 2026
fed_rate_environment.etn_implication: Moderately supportive. Rate cuts in H2 2026 would reduce financing costs for large infrastructure projects, Eaton's core market. But near-term (Q1-Q2) rates stay elevated.

etn_tariff_resilience.management_commentary: CEO noted tariffs in 2025 were 'mastered pretty well' with pricing actions. Company has 'playbook' for tariff mitigation.
